personalInfoHint: Add your contact details so employers can easily reach you.

pleaseFillRequired: Please fill in all required fields.
chooseTemplateSub: Instantly preview & use the template matching your career journey.
templatesNote: Not sure which style to choose? Start building and change the look whenever you like.
templateBenefitOne: A clear layout that makes your experience easy to scan
templateBenefitTwo: A professional style suited to a wide range of roles
templateBenefitThree: Make it yours with your details and preferred accent color
classicDesc: Traditional, chronological, and focused. Clean design that suits almost any industry and career level.
modernDesc: Clean blocks, minimal design with profile photo. Perfect for creative professionals and modern industries.
executiveDesc: Modern academic style with colored sections and progress indicators. Ideal for research and leadership roles.
sec_profile_desc: Add a short summary of your key strengths, experience, and career goals.
sec_education_desc: Add your degrees and schools. Include your focus, honors, or exchange terms.
sec_experience_desc: Add your professional roles and employer history including internships.
sec_skills_desc: Add your hard and soft skills that help you stand out from the crowd.
sec_languages_desc: Add your languages and proficiency levels to show your communication range.
sec_certificates_desc: Add your industry certificates or licenses. Include issuer and date earned.
sec_courses_desc: Add online or in-person courses and trainings you joined and completed.
sec_awards_desc: Add your awards and recognitions from industry, competitions, or academia.
sec_interests_desc: Add relevant personal interests that support your career story.
sec_projects_desc: Add key projects you participated in and highlight your role and impact.
sec_organisations_desc: Add your memberships or volunteering with organisations including your role.
sec_publications_desc: Add publications, articles, or books you wrote or contributed to.
sec_references_desc: Add your references from managers or coworkers, including contact details.
sec_declaration_desc: Add your declaration by creating or uploading your personal signature.
sec_custom_desc: Add a custom section for anything else, or combine sections cleanly.
footerDesc: Create, customize, and export stunning, ATS-friendly resumes in minutes.
